description: This PHP source file defines the BasicWorkSchedule class within the OrangeHRM system. It manages employee work schedules, integrating services such as work shifts, holidays, and workweeks, and provides methods to retrieve work shift details and determine non-working days.

classes.name: BasicWorkSchedule
classes.description: A class that manages employee work schedules, fetching shift times and determining holidays or non-working days based on configured services.

methods.name: getWorkShiftService
methods.description: Returns the WorkShiftService instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number associated with this schedule.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for this schedule.

methods.name: getWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the employee's work shift in hours.

methods.name: getWorkShiftStartEndTime
methods.description: Retrieves the start and end times of the employee's work shift.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Determines if a given day is a non-working day.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a half day holiday.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a half-day holiday.
